title: Rabbi Abba bar Bibi

paragraphs: Mentioned in Yalkut, Emor, remez 645; but Hyman traces the statement to Vayikra Rabbah 29:10 and Pesikta de-Rav Kahana, page 155a. There the reading is Rabbi Abba, son of R’ Pappi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: “There” leaves the precise scope of the Abba/Pappi variant implicit.

Torat Emet Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 645 has Rabbi Abba son of Rav Beivai. Midrash Rabbah–TE Vayikra Rabbah 29:10 has Rabbi Abba son of Rav Pappi; the Mandelbaum Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 23:11 has Rabbi Abba son of R’ Pappi. Hyman’s page 155a and the implicit scope of “there” are retained. R’ preserves the abbreviated Pappi title without harmonizing editions.
